done.title: First targeted xemu port: the APU VP mixer (vp.c)
done.evidence: TM8: hw/xbox/mcpx/apu/vp/vp.c is ported to managed C# behind the existing ApuDspCore seam and the APU produces real audio. Port: McpxApuDevice.Vp.cs (the per-frame voice-list walk with the idle-voice trap, both envelopes, PCM/ADPCM buffer and stream fetch through the SSL/SGE tables, resampling, the 8-tap volume/headroom mix into the 32 mix bins, multipass), Vp/ApuVpAdpcm.cs (adpcm_decode_block, BSD-3), Vp/ApuVpFilters.cs (svf.h + hrtf.h), Vp/ApuVpFrame.cs (geometry + fpconv.h); the front end gained SET_CURRENT_HRTF_ENTRY, SET_HRIR..SET_HRIR_X, SET_HRTF_SUBMIXES, SET_HRTF_HEADROOM, SET_SUBMIX_HEADROOM, and VOICE_ON now stores the ENVA/ENVF start phase and resets the voice filters. Cadence: one XGrid APU frame is 256 samples = eight of the reference's 32-sample frames (apu.c EP_FRAME_US), so the VP and the GP now run eight times per XGrid frame and the EP once (its ep_frame_div % 8 == 0 over 32-sample frames) - the old path ran the GP 8x too slow in guest time, which is why TM4's 6914 GP frames were 4.6 s of microcode spread over 38 s of guest time. Audio evidence (007): before, --apu-dsp --audio-out at 28B steps wrote 877,568 bytes of PCM that were ALL ZERO; now 2B steps from boot writes 377,856 bytes / 94,464 frames with 80,148 non-zero samples (42.4%), peak 7,500, RMS 1,023 (wt-data/tm8/007-audio-boot-2b.wav), and the 26B anchor + 2B writes 381,952 bytes / 95,488 frames with 90,925 non-zero (47.6%), peak 5,547, RMS 767 (wt-data/tm8/007-audio-26b-2b.wav); gpFrames=3200, epFrames=371, gpUndefined=0, gpLimitHits=0, LastFault vec=0 on both. It is audio and not noise: the RMS envelope has quiet and loud sections (to 3,157 at 1.6 s), mean|dL|/mean|L| = 0.126 (a smooth waveform; noise is ~1), the channels differ, and a DFT of the gameplay leg peaks at 105.5/152.3/199.2/316.4/503.9 Hz (a bass note and harmonics). Snapshot trap found and fixed: the TM4/TM5/TM6 anchors were captured WITHOUT --apu-dsp, so their payload says 'no DSP state' and the engines come up with no program (the guest wrote GPRST/EPRST before the anchor and never again) - LoadState now derives the run state from the restored reset registers and bootstraps the GP/EP from the restored scratch window on the next frame, which is what makes the 26B anchor audible. APU snapshot v6 appends the mixer state (headroom, HRTF submixes, 128 HRIR entries, per-voice SVF/HRTF history, resampler position); v2-v5 still load, so no .xgs is invalidated. Tests: tests/XGrid.Audio.Tests/ApuVpMixerTests.cs (12 cases) pins the ADPCM vector (0x1000 then 4103, 4104), the invalid step index, a buffer voice landing in the GP mix buffer at 0x400000, zero volume, submix headroom (2 bits = 1/4), the pitch path (one octave up consumes two source frames per output frame plus two lookahead frames), the attack envelope (level 239 at counter 15, full scale and hold at 17), the HRTF submix redirect, a stream voice walking its SSL segment and notifying, the SSL segment register window, a paused voice and a mixer-state snapshot round trip; XGrid.Audio gained InternalsVisibleTo for the test project.
